subject: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Dana Price <dana.price@healthsprout.com>, Tom Keller <tom.k@healthsprout.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks for the time earlier. Per our call, I put together a concise alignment sprint (attached) that lays out: objectives, owner responsibilities, week-by-week milestones, and the minimal acceptance tests we need to validate before a production signoff. Key asks from you:

- Confirm that the listed evaluation datasets (sheet: "Eval corpus") map to your internal dataset owners by EOD Tuesday.
- Flag any additional security/compliance evidence needed for SOC2/data residency in the acceptance column.
- If the SLA exception (page 3) is something procurement needs to review, please loop your legal contact.

Top-level proposal summary:
- 3-week MAP sprint starting Monday 5/25 (pilot workload days 1–10)
- Acceptance gates: smoke (latency/throughput), functional (concordance > 92% on sample prompts), safety (no PII leakage on 1k synthetic samples), and operational (KV cache warmup < 1s median).
- Signoff path: HealthSprout PoV lead -> Redwood AE (Ben) -> Product owner (Marissa) -> Exec signoff if SLA exception is requested.

I've attached: MAP_HealthSprout_v1.xlsx and acceptance_tests_v1.md — the latter enumerates individual acceptance test cases (input, expected behavior, owner).

If that looks good I’ll update the timeline and owner table and send a final MAP by Friday.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP_HealthSprout_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acceptance_tests_v1.md (text)

From: Dana Price <dana.price@healthsprout.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.k@healthsprout.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline

Hi Chloe —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. High level: this looks actionable and appropriately tight. Two immediate items from our side:

1) Security/compliance: our infosec team requires an explicit acceptance test for "audit log completeness" — we need to ensure every inference request includes traceable metadata (request id, model version, route). Can you add that to the operational gate?

2) Data residency: we need confirmation that any cached prefix data during the pilot will be stored only in us-west-2 and is TTL'd within 24 hours post-run.

I'll confirm dataset owners by tomorrow lunch. Also looping Tom for procurement visibility on any SLA exception paperwork.

Thanks,
Dana Price
Director of Data Products | HealthSprout
Dana.Price@healthsprout.com

Date: 2026-05-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline

Dana —

Thanks — good catches. I updated the acceptance_tests_v1.md to add:

- Operational / Audit logging completeness: test case that replays 500 requests and asserts presence of request_id, model_version, route, and timestamp in audit log (owner: Ben).
- Data residency: added explicit constraint for cache residency in us-west-2 with a 24-hour TTL applied to any prefix/KV caches created during pilot (owner: Infrastructure).

I also added a lightweight SLA exception template (SLA-exception-request.pdf) and marked it as "procurement review".

Ben — can you validate the audit log test and confirm we can produce the evidence within the pilot window? If yes I’ll push a rev to the MAP spreadsheet and lock the timeline.

Chloe

Attachments: acceptance_tests_v1.md (updated), SLA-exception-request.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dana Price <dana.price@healthsprout.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline

Chloe / Dana —

Confirmed. Audit log completeness test is feasible within the MAP window. Plan:
- Run 1k synthetic requests against the pilot endpoint during week 2 (owner: Ben).
- Export logs to a temporary bucket in us-west-2, run a verification script that checks the required fields and generates a PDF evidence pack.
- Estimated work: 4 engineer-hours to wire the export and a 1-hour run for verification.

Also added two small acceptance items to the document:
- Canary rollback trigger: >5% error-rate for sustained 20 minutes -> automatic rollback to previous model variant.
- Performance floor: 95th percentile latency must be < 400ms for standard prompts; if breached, we pause ramp and investigate.

Marissa — can you slot the executive signoff checkpoint into your calendar for 6/12 if we start the MAP on 5/25? That gives us time to collect evidence and run a 3-day smoke window.

Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Alignment sprint: MAP milestones, acceptance protocol, and close timeline

All —

Thanks for converging. I reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and acceptance tests. A few operational notes to make the close timeline clean:

- Final MAP freeze: 2026-05-22 17:00 PDT — after that only critical changes.
- Pilot start: 2026-05-25 — pilot workload runs 5/25–6/04.
- Evidence pack deliverable: 2026-06-08 (Ben to deliver audit log PDF, Chloe to deliver sample concordance report, HealthSprout to confirm dataset owner signoff).
- Executive review & signoff meeting: 2026-06-12 11:00 PDT (30 min). I'll prepare the signoff slide deck (brief: objectives, acceptance evidence, residual risks, recommended go/no-go).

One final ask for HealthSprout: please provide the name and email of the procurement/legal reviewer who will handle SLA exceptions by Friday 5/22. That keeps the contract redline loop from delaying the 6/12 signoff.

I'll attach the MAP final (MAP_HealthSprout_v1.xlsx) to the calendar invite after the freeze.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Product | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_HealthSprout_v1.xlsx (final for freeze)
